title: Senior Product Manager - AI
description:
Allow us to introduce ourselves

Hello there! We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions.

We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we’re now humbled to call the world our playground, with over 260 employees spread across 13 countries (we’re remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from +190 markets, globally.

Want to be a part of the Appinio movement? 🚀

Here at Appinio, we value transparency in our recruitment process, and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together: here

Your mission as a Senior Product Manager:

We are seeking a proven, disciplined Senior Product Manager who has mastered the core crafts of product management—discovery, structured strategy, rigorous execution, and outcome-driven roadmap delivery within a B2B SaaS environment.

You will own the bridge between advanced machine learning systems and real-world customer value. You’ll partner closely with our engineering team and Engineering Leads to build our core AI architecture and harness, as well as AI-enabled user-facing features that keep Appinio ahead of the curve. 

What you’ll be doing:

  • Craft and execute our AI strategy by shaping the end-to-end vision, value proposition, and roadmap for flagship AI initiatives, balancing long-term technical foundations with high-impact customer features.
  • Drive complete end-to-end product ownership, taking features from initial strategy and discovery through to architecture, execution, iteration, and measurable business impact.
  • Build and scale our internal AI harness through direct partnership with your cross functional engineering squad and their Lead to establish robust evaluation frameworks, LLM orchestration, model routing, and prompt engineering infrastructure that keep our systems reliable, scalable, and cost-effective.
  • Practice rigorous product craft through deep user discovery, clear and actionable PRDs, tracking and tight success metrics (OKRs), and disciplined execution driven by rapid experimentation.
  • Elevate team AI and PM fluency by leading as an AI-native PM, mentoring cross-functional team members, and fostering a culture of continuous learning, data fluency, and high performance.

You will thrive in this role if:

  • You bring essential B2B SaaS experience with a proven track record of owning platform products end-to-end, alongside a deep understanding of multi-tenant workflows, complex user personas, and scaling software.
  • You possess battle-tested PM fundamentals, backed by several years of experience as a Product Manager with demonstrated mastery in core PM frameworks, quantitative/qualitative research, and outcome-based execution.
  • You have a hands-on AI/ML track record, including direct experience working with AI engineers/teams to bring non-deterministic software, LLM applications, or agentic frameworks into production. Experience with LLM-as-a-judge. 
  • You maintain a strong technical and strategic balance, able to speak the language of engineering (RAG, vector databases, model evals, API latency) while translating technical capabilities into measurable business impact (revenue, efficiency, retention).
  • You communicate with precision. Complex AI tradeoffs become a clear recommendation, a decision, and a quality bar other squads can reuse.
  • You have an interest and a passion in the products we are building at Appinio with the vision to create the coolest market-research product in the world

This post not only outlines our ideal candidate but also serves as an inspiration for what this role can evolve into. Even if you consider yourself an 80% fit but have a genuine passion for this position, we encourage you to apply. We're eager to hear from individuals who share our enthusiasm.

Appinio is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

title: Director Data Strategy (Mensch)
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

WPP steht für kreative Transformation. Mit der Kraft von Kreativität gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kunden, unsere Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten. Genau hier setzt WPP Media an: Als globales Mediennetzwerk von WPP vereinen wir die besten Plattformen, Talente und Partner, um in einer vernetzten Medienwelt neue Chancen für grenzenloses Wachstum zu schaffen.

 

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Work-Life-Balance: Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten mit Schwerpunkt auf dem persönlichen Austausch im Office und ergänzender Remote Work passt sich dein Job deinem Leben an. Überstunden kannst du flexible ausgleichen.
  • Vacation mode on: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.
  • Wellbeing first: Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.
  • Practice makes perfect: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.
  • More than just a job: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.
  • Be yourself: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.

 

Das bewegst du:

Als Director Data Strategy Consulting (Mensch) bist du das strategische Rückgrat, das Gesicht und das unternehmerische Bindeglied unserer Data-Strategy-Unit. Du verantwortest die End-to-End-Datenstrategie für unsere Fokus-Kunden – von der strategischen Gestaltung über die Steuerung von Technologie-Roadmaps bis zur kommerziellen Weiterentwicklung – und leitest, inspirierst und entwickelst dabei ein hochqualifiziertes Team von Data Strategists.

  • Teamführung: Du leitest, inspirierst und entwickelst ein hochqualifiziertes Team von Data Strategists und schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem dein Team über sich hinauswachsen kann.
  • Strategische Datenanwendung & Kundenentwicklung: Du verantwortest die End-to-End-Datenstrategie für unsere Fokus-Kunden und agierst als strategisches Rückgrat unserer Data-Strategy-Unit. Durch die Priorisierung von First-Party-Data-Kollaborationen, Private Data Networks und KI-gestützter Planung entwickelst du audience-first-Strategien über 1PD-, 2PD- und 3PD-Daten hinweg und übersetzt Datenpotenziale in messbare Business-Erfolge – von Wachstum über Effizienz bis hin zu Effektivität.
  • Daten- & Technologie-Roadmap: Du gestaltest den Einsatz moderner Werbetechnologien wie Data Clean Rooms, CDPs und DSPs und verbindest Kunden-Roadmaps mit Innovationen in den Bereichen KI, Audience-Produkte und Measurement. Dabei triffst du strategische Entscheidungen zu Datenpartnerschaften und Aktivierungspfaden, bindest globale Lösungen wie WPP Open, Open Media Studio, Open Intelligence und InfoSum ein und bringst Marktanforderungen in globale Produkt-Roadmaps ein.
  • Kunden- & Stakeholder-Management: Als strategische:r Berater:in begleitest du Marketing-, Media-, Daten- und Commerce-Verantwortliche auf Entscheider-Ebene. Geschäftsziele übersetzt du in datengetriebene Strategien und Umsetzungspläne und verknüpfst Datenstrategie mit Media-Ergebnissen und messbarem Business Impact.
  • Enablement & Kompetenzaufbau: Du entwickelst marktreife Playbooks und etablierst Standards für Audience-Strategien, Governance und Entscheidungsprozesse. In Strategie-Workshops stärkst du datenstrategische Kompetenzen sowie die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Kunden- und Agenturteams.
  • Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Du verantwortest das Kunden-Outcome-Portfolio und steuerst gemeinsam mit Client Analytics & Data Science, Data & Technology Consulting und Product Enablement die erfolgreiche Umsetzung datenstrategischer Lösungen. Dabei überführst du Erkenntnisse in konkrete Entscheidungen und Maßnahmen.
  • Unternehmertum: Du steuerst das Neugeschäft im Bereich Data Strategy, sicherst die Wirtschaftlichkeit deines Verantwortungsbereichs und entwickelst belastbare Business Cases. Auf Basis nachgewiesener Ergebnisse identifizierst du Cross- und Upselling-Potenziale und treibst nachhaltiges Wachstum voran.
  • Thought Leadership: Du positionierst WPP Media als Vordenker für moderne Datenstrategie und machst den Business Impact datengetriebener Lösungen durch Executive Briefings, Case Studies und POVs sichtbar.
  • Führungskultur: Als Vorbild für Inclusive Leadership förderst du Diversität, Eigenverantwortung und eine Kultur der Wertschätzung, Zusammenarbeit und des gemeinsamen Erfolgs.

 

Das zeichnet dich aus:

  • Führungserfahrung: Nachweisbare, mehrjährige Erfahrung (mind. 2–3 Jahre) in der disziplinarischen und fachlichen Führung sowie in der Entwicklung von Teams.
  • Branchenexpertise: Mindestens 7 Jahre relevante Erfahrung im datengetriebenen Marketing, der Media-, Beratungs- oder AdTech/MarTech-Branche, mit praktischer Erfahrung in der Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Datenstrategien.
  • Fachkompetenz: Tiefgehendes Verständnis von Dateninfrastrukturen, Data Clean Rooms (z. B. InfoSum), CDPs, DSPs, Tagging, Analytics sowie von KI/ML-Konzepten im Marketing – mit der Fähigkeit, Anforderungen zu definieren und mit Fachspezialist:innen in die Umsetzung zu bringen.
  • Datenkompetenz: Sichere praktische Anwendung von 1PD/2PD/3PD-Daten sowie Kunden-, Business- und Marketingdaten in der Datenkollaboration und -aktivierung.
  • Methodenwissen: Fundiertes Wissen in den Bereichen Measurement, Incrementality-Frameworks sowie im agilen Projekt- und Change-Management; Erfahrung in der Steuerung mehrgleisiger Programme mit klaren Routinen und Dokumentation.
  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Eine klare Vision für deinen Einflussbereich, ein ausgeprägter Gestaltungswille und ein exzellentes Standing bei Kunden und Kollegen.
  • Netzwerkkompetenz: Als kollaborativer Matrix-Networker suchst du aktiv den Austausch über alle Hierarchieebenen hinweg und zeichnest dich durch hohe Problemlösungskompetenz aus.
  • Kommunikationsstärke: Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen einfach zu erklären und Vertrauen bei Kunden- und Agentur-Counterparts aufzubauen.
  • Ausbildung: Abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor) erforderlich, ein weiterführender Abschluss ist von Vorteil.

Darüber hinaus bist du: #teamfähig #lösungsorientiert #kommunikativ

Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.

Arbeiten bei WPP Media:

Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.
 
WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen.

description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

The Role

The Territory Account Executive (TAE) is a key growth role within Everpure (formerly Pure Storage) Germany's Go-To-Market organisation. This position focuses on driving growth across all accounts not currently managed by an Account Executive, including the full install base, dormant accounts, and new inbound opportunities. TAEs are responsible for expanding Pure’s footprint, reigniting customer relationships, and capturing new business through a combination of direct engagement and partner collaboration.

As a Territory Account Executive (TAE), you’ll play a pivotal role in bringing this vision to life - helping customers unlock the power of their data, modernise their infrastructure, and accelerate transformation. You’ll join our Commercial team in Germany, with the autonomy to own a dynamic territory, driving growth across a broad set of customers, from re-engaging dormant relationships to winning new logos.

At Pure, you’ll join a culture built on curiosity, innovation, and integrity. We celebrate diverse perspectives, challenge convention, and empower our people to think big, take bold action, and make a measurable impact. This is your opportunity to grow your career with one of the most innovative technology companies in the world and to do work that truly changes how businesses use data to compete and win.

 

What You'll Do

  • Drive Account Growth & Pipeline: Execute sales activities to generate revenue, manage a high-volume pipeline, and contribute to closing deals on a quarterly basis.
  • Execute Outreach & Prospecting: Perform consistent, high-activity prospecting to penetrate new accounts, reach decision-makers, and learn how to win new business effectively.
  • Support Partner Strategy: Collaborate closely with Channel Partners and Partner Managers to align on customer engagement and utilise partner resources to advance opportunities.
  • Reactivate Customer Relationships: Focus on re-engaging dormant or inactive customers by discovering new business use cases and identifying potential refresh and expansion opportunities.
  • Build Foundational Skills: Develop and deliver proposals and business cases that clearly demonstrate the value of Pure's solutions, supported by internal experts.
  • Maintain Sales Discipline: Diligently manage sales technology (Salesforce), deliver accurate forecasts, and maintain strong time management to thrive in a fast-paced, team environment.

What You Bring

  • Proven Sales Experience: Demonstrated success in direct, full-lifecycle B2B technology sales with a consistent record of meeting or exceeding sales metrics (KPIs).
  • Sales Drive & Motivation: A high degree of self-motivation, strong time management skills, demonstrates initiative and the drive to learn quickly and succeed across both transactional and early-stage strategic sales motions. 
  • Collaborative Mindset: Demonstrated success working with both internal teams and channel partners to ensure seamless customer engagement and shared goal achievement.
  • Digital Proficiency: Proficiency with core sales technologies, including Salesforce and G Suite, and an ability to use data to prioritise daily activities. 
  • Communication & Presence: Strong verbal and written communication skills suitable for engaging with business leaders and maintaining professional business relationships.
  • Resilience & Focus: A competitive, positive attitude combined with strong organisational and time management skills necessary to handle a dynamic, high-activity territory.
  • Language Skills: Business Level, written and spoken, German and English language skills required.

Nice to Have

  • Industry Knowledge: Prior knowledge of the storage industry and familiarity with how data solutions drive business outcomes.
  • Channel Sales Expertise: Understanding of channel-led sales motions and experience collaborating effectively within the broader partner ecosystem.
  • Sales Training: Completion of a structured B2B sales methodology training (e.g., Business Value Selling or similar).
  • Digital Tools: Experience using digital prospecting and engagement tools (e.g., Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) to accelerate the sales cycle.

Join Everpure Germany team and be part of a team that's redefining data storage. Apply now and unleash your potential!

Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire, with millions of users, growing rapidly year-on-year. And, we're still in the early days of our product roadmap and potential impact on people's everyday lives.

We're looking for an engineer who's independent and excited about getting things done. You'll be responsible for building and improving the ways people pay with Wave. You'll own every step of the process: from understanding the problem to shipping your solution to users to helping the customer support team resolve problems.

You'll join an autonomous, cross-functional team focused on a single area of Wave's product. Each team is led by a Product Manager and an Engineering Manager or Tech Lead.   • backend: Python 3 (+ mypy)
  • API layer: GraphQL
  • android frontend: Kotlin/Jetpack
  • iOS frontend: Swift/SwiftUI
  • web frontend: TypeScript/React
  • database: Postgres/CockroachDB
  • infrastructure: GCP/Terraform
  • orchestration: Kubernetes

We expect all engineers to be willing to work across the entire stack, including mobile. Prior experience in these technologies is a strong plus, but not required.

  • Are excited to deeply understand the inner workings of the tools you use.

We leave TODOs and file follow-ups. We don't over-perfect v1. That said, we're building a financial product. Some things—like money movement, correctness, or security—deserve more caution.

This keeps us focused on solving meaningful problems instead of wrestling with unpredictable infrastructure. If a new technology helps us move faster, build safer, or solve a real need, we'll consider it. But we don't adopt tools just because they're new—we adopt them because they're right.

With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. About the Role:

At Camunda, we are evolving how software gets built. We are looking for a Product Builder to help shape the enterprise and governance experience of Camunda Hub by combining product thinking, user empathy, UX judgment, and hands-on execution. This is a high-ownership role inside our Products organization for someone who wants to move quickly, work directly with customers and forward deployed engineers, and build in an AI-first environment.

Camunda Hub is the unified management platform through which teams govern their processes, manage access, and administer the platform at enterprise scale. You will join the Enterprise & Governance pod, which owns the surfaces enterprise Centres of Excellence and platform administrators rely on: access control and permissions, workspace and tenant management, audit and compliance features, and the administration and configuration UI for clusters and platform settings.

The role will contribute across the full stack, enabling faster end-to-end product delivery.

What you'll be doing:

  •  Discover and clarify meaningful user problems for administrators, CoE teams, and enterprise architects by working closely with customers, forward deployed engineers, and internal stakeholders

  • Shape product direction through practical judgment, fast iteration, and a strong focus on solving the underlying problem rather than only implementing requests

  • Prototype, build, harden, ship, and iterate on product improvements across the enterprise and governance surfaces of Hub - access control, workspace and tenant management, audit and compliance, and platform administration

  • Use AI tools effectively to accelerate first drafts, implementation steps, iteration, and learning while maintaining a strong quality bar

  • Work closely with other builders and product strategy counterparts to turn ideas into shipped outcomes, including across boundaries with Core / Identity where governance surfaces build on platform contracts

  • Improve the speed, quality, and effectiveness of how the pod delivers product end-to-end

What you bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

  • Experience shipping product directly in a software environment

  • Ability to work fluidly across product thinking, user experience, and hands-on delivery

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and turning open-ended problems into practical next steps

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills in a remote-first, pod-based environment

  • Curiosity about users, fast learning loops, and a bias toward improving the product through iteration

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping product in a software context, not only coordinating roadmap or requirements

  • Strong AI-native delivery habits: able to use AI tools effectively for first drafts, implementation steps, and iteration, while reviewing and improving weak output rather than accepting it

  • Ability to describe and shape intended user experience clearly, including flow, hierarchy, states, copy, and accessibility expectations

  • Strong product and customer judgment: able to understand the user problem behind a request, use lightweight evidence and customer feedback, and make pragmatic decisions that create broader product value

  • Sound technical judgment within an established architecture, including the ability to test what was built, trace issues, understand frontend/backend boundaries, and contribute beyond a pure frontend scope over time

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with workflow software, orchestration, admin/platform tooling, or similarly technical product surfaces

  • Experience working in small, high-autonomy pods with broad ownership across discovery, design, and delivery

  • Familiarity with enterprise governance concerns: identity and access management, RBAC and permission models, multi-tenancy, audit logging, or compliance-driven requirements

  • Experience designing for administrator and platform-operator personas

  • Ability to capture validation learnings clearly, distinguish signal from noise, and help improve lightweight product validation practices

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Who we are: Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products. Our culture: We have hubs in the Bay Area, NYC, Austin, Toronto, and São Paulo. However, we maintain a remote-first work culture. #WorkFromAnywhere We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation. We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule. Location: Remote - Germany From Home / Beach / Mountain / Cafe / Anywhere! We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed team. You can find your productive zone and work from there. About the Role: As a DevOps Engineer at Sardine, you'll play a critical role in evolving our infrastructure and platform tooling to support a growing engineering team. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you’ll drive key initiatives across deployment, observability, developer productivity, and cloud cost management. You’ll work closely with application engineers, QA, and cross-functional stakeholders like Security and Finance to ensure our systems are reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient. The role involves building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, improving system observability, optimizing cloud usage through FinOps governance, and strengthening our platform’s resilience. While we have core tools in place, we’re looking for someone who can both own and elevate them by identifying gaps, improving automation, and proactively driving improvements. This is an ideal role for someone who brings deep technical expertise, thrives in high-ownership environments, and is excited to shape the future of DevOps. What you'll be doing: Own and evolve our DevOps and platform engineering function, from build and deployment pipelines to monitoring, infrastructure as code, and cost optimization. Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines that are secure, scalable, and built to support rapid product iterations without sacrificing stability. Improve observability via Datadog, GCP, and custom dashboards, including FinOps focused observability outcomes. Implement and maintain FinOps governance, including showback and chargeback models, to drive cost accountability across engineering teams. Enable developer productivity by creating internal tooling, reusable modules, and simplifying infrastructure for other engineering teams. Help teams define and measure SLOs setting the standard for how we think about system health and reliability. Serve as a FinOps thought leader, collaborating with Product and Engineering to define the most cost-effective architectural patterns for new services and features. Play a key role in shaping our engineering culture, DevOps best practices, and influencing our long-term DevOps roadmap. Work cross-functionally with product engineering, security, finance, and other teams to align technical spending with business unit economics and financial goals. What you'll need: 6+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or software engineering roles, ideally in high-growth startup environments Proficiency in Python or Go, with strong software engineering fundamentals Proven ownership of production infrastructure and platform tooling, with strong debugging skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex distributed systems and diagnose unforeseen financial spikes Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing highly secure and robust infrastructure, particularly in environments with stringent regulatory requirements such as those used by government agencies and major financial institutions Deep experience with Kubernetes and tools like ArgoCD, Helm, and Terraform Familiarity with GCP (preferred) or other major cloud providers, with a deep focus on cloud cost management, leveraging reserved instances/savings plans, and implementing cost anomaly detection Hands-on experience with dedicated FinOps tooling (e.g., Kubecost, AWS Cost Explorer, GCP Cloud Billing, DoIT Cloud Intelligence) or building custom tooling for cost allocation and reporting. Strong experience building CI/CD pipelines and internal developer tooling from the ground up Hands-on experience with observability tools like Prometheus or Datadog, and participation in an on-call rotation Benefits we offer: Generous compensation in cash and equity Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture Flexible paid time off and Year-end break Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific MacBook Pro delivered to your door One-time stipend to set up a home office — desk, chair, screen, etc. Monthly meal stipend Monthly social meet-up stipend Annual health and wellness stipend Annual Learning stipend Join a fast-growing company with world-class professionals from around the world. If you are seeking a meaningful career, you found the right place, and we would love to hear from you. title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager
description: Company Overview Mindpeak is a Hamburg-based AI company on a mission to make cancer diagnosis more accurate, efficient and personalized. We build deep-learning solutions for computational pathology that bring AI directly into clinical practice. Our technology is already used in routine diagnostics across more than 25 countries and supports leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies in developing and advancing new cancer treatments. What makes Mindpeak special is the combination of disciplines required to make this work. Software engineers and machine learning experts work alongside pathologists, scientists, product specialists and commercial teams to turn cutting-edge AI into products that deliver real value in healthcare. This also makes building our team unusually interesting. Many of the people we hire sit at the intersection of different disciplines and are difficult to find through conventional recruiting. Identifying exceptional talent, understanding what great looks like and building hiring processes that allow us to make consistently strong decisions are therefore critical to Mindpeak’s next stage of growth. The Role We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Manager to take ownership of recruiting across Mindpeak. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who genuinely enjoys recruiting and sees Talent Acquisition itself as their profession. You will recruit across different functions, with a particular focus on senior, business-critical and hard-to-fill roles spanning Product, Technology and Business. You will work closely with our founders and hiring managers to define what we actually need, identify what great looks like for each role and translate this into rigorous, efficient hiring processes. This is a hands-on recruiting role, not a generalist People & Culture or Organizational Development position. You will personally run critical searches, source candidates, conduct interviews and close hires. At the same time, we expect you to help raise the quality of hiring across Mindpeak by challenging unclear requirements, improving interview practices and bringing structure and discipline to how we make hiring decisions. You will not inherit a recruiting team, but you will have the mandate and budget to work with external recruiters and specialist search partners where they add value. Your Mission Own the full recruiting cycle : from search strategy, sourcing and screening through interviews, offers and closing. Partner with our CEO and hiring managers as a trusted talent advisor : clarify requirements, challenge assumptionsand drive decisions forward. Proactively identify and engage high-quality candidates , particularly for senior, leadership and hard-to-fill roles. Run high-quality interviews that go beyond CVs and polished answers, uncovering concrete evidence of impact, decision-making and individual contribution. Select, brief and actively manage external recruiters and search partners where they add value. Keep pipelines, bottlenecks and risks transparent for leadership, and keep improving how Mindpeak hires without unnecessary bureaucracy. What Success Looks Like Priority searches run with clear role profiles and explicit assessment criteria, even when requirements start out ambiguous. You successfully engage high-quality passive candidates and build genuine interest in Mindpeak and our roles. Interviews across Mindpeak become more rigorous and consistent , based on evidence rather than titles or impressions. Most importantly, critical roles get closed with people who raise the quality of the organisation. Your Experience Substantial hands-on experience owning full-cycle recruiting; a background in executive search or another environment with a strong sourcing and assessment culture is a plus. Proven track record of closing senior, leadership and hard-to-fill searches , with strong active sourcing skills and confidence approaching passive candidates. Experience in a technology-driven, high-growth environment , recruiting across functions such as Product, Technology and Business. You don't need to be technical, but you understand how these teams work well enough to recruit credibly. Experience working directly with founders or demanding senior hiring managers and influencing their decisions rather than simply executing requirements. Experience translating unclear business needs into clear role profiles, scorecards and structured interview processes. Experience selecting and managing external agencies or headhunters . Fluent English ; German is an advantage but not essential. Your Profile You interview for evidence and have strong talent judgment. You can tell an impressive CV or polished answer from real evidence that someone will succeed. You know what good looks like and can credibly bring that standard into an organisation still developing its own. You challenge senior stakeholders constructively and communicate clearly and directly with executives, hiring managers and senior candidates alike. You take ownership. When a search isn't working, you diagnose why and change the approach, and you know when requirements need to change. You create structure without bureaucracy , just enough process to improve speed, quality and accountability. You learn quickly and immerse yourself in unfamiliar domains until you can recruit credibly in them. Why Mindpeak Take real ownership of Talent Acquisition in a growing AI company where hiring exceptional people has a direct impact on the success of the business. Recruit across some of the most interesting talent markets today – from AI and software engineering to medicine, science and commercial roles. Work directly with our founders and senior leaders Shape and continuously improve how we identify, assess and hire exceptional people rather than simply executing a fixed corporate recruiting process. See the impact of the teams you build on cancer diagnostics and treatment. Work from our centrally located Hamburg office with a beautiful view over the harbor. Application Details Please send us: Your CV and reference letters Your salary expectations Your earliest possible starting date Note: Direct applicants only. We do not work with recruiting agencies for this position. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Werkstudent im Bereich Legal / Compliance (d/m/w)
description: Ihre Aufgaben Bei NYALA begleitest Du die Weiterentwicklung unseres Angebots von juristischer Seite. Du lernst, regulatorische Anforderungen umzusetzen sowie zu diesen mit den Aufsichtsbehörden zu kommunizieren. Dabei wendest Du den bestehenden Rechtsrahmen aus eWpG, eWpRV, KWG und GwG an, entwickelst unsere Produkte in diesem weiter, begleitest mit uns aktuelle Entwicklungen bei der Gesetzgebung und nimmst über Stellungnahmen und Konsultationen aktiv Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung der Gesetzgebung zur Blockchain-Technologie. Du hast damit nicht nur die Möglichkeit, die geltenden Regelungen auf konkrete Sachverhalte im Unternehmen anzuwenden (und das anders als in der Kanzlei umfassend und gestaltend, nicht nur im Rahmen eines beschränkten Beratungsauftrags), sondern auch zukünftige Entwicklungen aktiv mitzugestalten. Im operativen Tagesgeschäft arbeitest du direkt dem Geldwäsche-, Compliance- und Risikobeauftragten zu, bereitest Sachverhalte entscheidungsreif auf und hältst Fristen, Maßnahmen und Wiedervorlagen nach. Im Schwerpunkt des Berichtswesens erstellst du Vorlagen für die Berichte an Funktionsträger im Unternehmen, pflegst Kennzahlen und Auswertungen, hältst Richtlinien, Handbücher und Arbeitsanweisungen aktuell und unterstützt bei Jahresabschluss- und Sonderprüfungen. Ihr Profil Du brennst für Technologie und speziell DLT, glaubst an die revolutionäre Chance der Blockchain im Finanzsystem und hast Interesse an kapitalmarktrechtlichen Fragestellungen. Sobald ein Creative bei einem Kunden zieht, lässt du daraus AI-gestützt binnen kurzer Zeit ein ganzes Set an Varianten entstehen – andere Hooks, neue Formate, kürzere und längere Schnitte – und bringst sie parallel in den jeweiligen Account. Jede Version bleibt klar auf die Marke des Kunden zugeschnitten, und was weiterläuft, entscheiden die Zahlen, nicht das Bauchgefühl. Produktentwicklung & Workflows Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Produkt-Team unseren AI-Creative-Stack weiter und gestaltest Systeme, mit denen wir deutlich mehr hochwertige Werbemittel in kürzerer Zeit produzieren können. Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Content, AI, Performance Marketing und Produkt und übersetzt operative Anforderungen in skalierbare Prozesse und Produktideen Du musst dabei nicht jeden technischen Prozess selbst programmieren oder bauen. Entscheidend ist, dass du verstehst, was mit AI, Automatisierungen und modernen Tools möglich ist, wo technische Grenzen liegen und wie ein sinnvoller Workflow aussehen sollte Wenn du Workflows, Automatisierungen oder Prototypen selbst bauen kannst: umso besser. Bei komplexeren Lösungen arbeitest du eng mit unserem Produkt- und Tech-Team zusammen und bringst die fachlichen Anforderungen ein Automatisierte Content-Produktion Du arbeitest täglich mit Tools wie Claude Code & Design, Make, Higgsfield. HeyGen, Midjourney, Runway, Nano Banana, und weiteren AI-Tools und verbindest sie sinnvoll miteinander Du entwickelst Systeme, die aus Projektinformationen automatisiert unterschiedliche Paid-Social-Content, Videos, Landingpages und Creative-Varianten generieren können Du automatisierst die Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Landingpages und sorgst dafür, dass aus wenigen Inputs möglichst schnell hochwertige, conversionstarke Seiten entstehen Du entwickelst und automatisierst AI-Video-Workflows – von der ersten Idee über unterschiedliche Hooks und Szenen bis hin zu Varianten, Formaten und Cutdowns Creative-Produktion & Performance Du entwickelst High-Performing Creatives für Paid Ads selbst – Static Ads, Video, Motion, Landingpages und neue Formate Du liest unsere Performance-Dashboards selbst , erkennst Muster und übersetzt die Daten direkt in neue Creative-Hypothesen und Iterationen Du analysierst unter anderem Hook Rate, CTR, Conversion Rate, CPL, CPA und ROAS und nutzt diese Erkenntnisse, um unsere Creative-Produktion kontinuierlich besser zu machen Tooling, UX & Marktbeobachtung Du gestaltest auch die UX/UI unserer internen AI-Tools und Workflows mit. Dein Anspruch: Komplexe Technologie muss so einfach werden, dass jede Person im Team sie intuitiv nutzen kann Du beobachtest den AI-Markt kontinuierlich und erkennst früh, welche neuen Modelle, Tools und Workflows einen echten Vorteil bringen Du testest neue Technologien schnell und pragmatisch. Wenn ein neues Tool unseren bestehenden Prozess deutlich verbessert, integrierst du es – statt an bestehenden Lösungen festzuhalten Das bringst du idealerweise mit: Du bringst mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Content, Creative, AI, Automation oder einem vergleichbaren digitalen Umfeld mit. Tools wie Nano Banana, Runway, Midjourney oder vergleichbare Lösungen hast du dir idealerweise selbst beigebracht – und du beschäftigst dich bereits mit den Tools, die sie morgen ersetzen könnten. Du verstehst nicht nur einzelne AI-Tools, sondern kannst erkennen, wie unterschiedliche Tools zu einem sinnvollen Workflow zusammenspielen . Du hast Spaß daran, Prozesse zu automatisieren und stellst dir regelmäßig die Frage: Warum machen wir das eigentlich noch manuell? Identify the platforms, applications, standards and ecosystem players that matter to our customers, and shape the integrations, certifications and technology partnerships that strengthen our proposition. You are commercially minded and naturally connect product decisions with customer value, differentiation, business impact and opportunities to capture value. You have enough technical depth to understand architecture, interfaces and trade-offs, contribute credibly to platform and integration discussions, and recognize when deeper engineering expertise is needed. You think in systems and patterns: when faced with a customer requirement, you look beyond the immediate request to understand why it exists, how broadly it applies and what a simple, repeatable solution could look like. Platform or ecosystem strategy, technology partnerships, certification programs or developer and partner ecosystems. Enterprise customers deploying technology at scale. Customers can adopt, integrate, deploy and manage ProGlove devices more easily within their existing enterprise environments. Your profile

At ProGlove, technical expertise matters, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and turns complexity into clear, pragmatic decisions.

This is a highly cross-functional role. You will bring together customer needs, technical realities and commercial opportunities, while also building relationships with external technology partners, platform providers and integrators. Our Order and Inventory Management Team is looking for a Support Engineer (f/m/d) - Domain Manager on a Permanent Contract based in Lille.

Passionate about logistics innovation, our team of 10 designs and operates the global digital solutions orchestrating Decathlon's order and stock flows. Our impact: guaranteeing the right product in the right place at the right time for our stores, warehouses, and marketplaces worldwide. Our challenges: accelerating the group's digital transformation, integrating new business models (circular economy, wholesale), and preparing the transition to SAP S/4HANA.

YOUR FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

As a Support Engineer (f/m/d), you will ensure the stability, efficiency, and evolution of our order and stock orchestration tools. Your core responsibilities include:

  • Run Management & User Commitments: Organize daily ticket resolution, ensure service level agreements (stock accuracy KPIs, dispatch timing), and provide dedicated support during peak commercial periods.

  • Incident Resolution & Continuous Improvement: Perform root cause analysis, enhance monitoring tools (dashboards, control towers), and automate recurring tasks leveraging tech and AI.

  • Transformation Projects & SAP: Challenge upcoming product features with the project team, drive updates on our SAP ECC module (SD/MM), and help prepare the S/4HANA migration planned for 2028.

  • Communication & On-Call Rotations: Maintain transparent communication with stakeholders during incidents or maintenance, and participate in on-call rotations for critical operations.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Education & Background: Engineering degree (preferably in Computer Science) or equivalent experience.

  • Functional & Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of supply chain processes combined with proven experience on SAP modules (SD and MM).

  • Automation Mindset: Passion for eliminating manual repetitive tasks, tracking data performance, and integrating AI into daily operations.

  • Soft Skills: Team player spirit ("Play Collective"), clear communication, strong prioritization skills, and collaborative leadership.

  • Languages: Fluent English is mandatory (daily international scope).

TECH STACK

  • ERP / Systems: SAP ECC (SD & MM modules), S/4HANA roadmap.

  • Monitoring & Data: Operational control towers, ticketing systems, and custom monitoring dashboards.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Hybrid work organization (up to 2 days of remote work per week);

  • Equipment provided in line with your role and our sustainability commitments (Mac, Windows, or Chromebook);

  • A local project team within a global network (international career opportunities);

  • Continuous learning and development (technical certifications in year one, internal/external training programs);

  • Comprehensive compensation package (employee stock ownership scheme, monthly/quarterly bonuses).

OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION AND ACCESSIBILITY

At Decathlon, we recognize the immense value that diversity brings to our teams, and we continuously strive to foster and cultivate an inclusive and equitable workplace: this is why Inclusion is one of our Human Fundamentals. We encourage people of all backgrounds and abilities to apply, as we firmly believe that diversity of thought, culture, identity, and lived experience makes us stronger.

Decathlon is also committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the process, you can request them via the application form; your request will remain confidential and will not affect the outcome of your hiring process.

 

DECATHLON DIGITAL CONTEXT 

What if technology allowed us to push the boundaries and take sports experiences to new levels? That's exactly our goal at Decathlon Digital! We are a team of 5,000+ experts in software engineering, product management, data, cloud, and cybersecurity, distributed across Paris, Lille, and Amsterdam. Together, we are creating the largest digital sports platform, leveraging tech innovation from design to value chain optimization, connected experiences and product second life.


Changing the game for good. We are in this for the love of sports. And like everything we love, we want it to last. That’s why we are embarking on a journey to create a more sustainable tech model, reducing our direct environmental impact while maintaining a safe, diverse, and inclusive space for all our people to learn and thrive together. Team up with us to design the digital future of sports.

Unsere Kunden sollen nicht hinter Informationen herlaufen müssen. Prozesse verstehen und automatisieren: Du entwickelst unsere bestehenden Systeme mit Airtable, Make, n8n, Claude und ChatGPT weiter. Beispiel Welcome-Paket: einmal selbst packen, anschließend den automatisierten Versand über einen Dienstleister aufbauen – inklusive Versandkontrolle. Morgens Technik anschließen, später mit einem Geschäftsführer über digitale Prozesse sprechen: Genau diese Mischung gehört zur Stelle. Wachstum mitgestalten: Direkt mit der Geschäftsführung setzt du Digitalisierungsprojekte um. Perspektivisch entwickelst du internationale Abläufe oder neue KI-Angebote für unsere Kunden mit. Du musst weder verkaufen noch selbst Coachings geben. Dein Schwerpunkt bleibt die Verantwortung für unsere Operations. Zuerst übernimmst und verbesserst du bestehende Abläufe. Darauf baust du zusätzliche Verantwortung auf – nicht alles gleichzeitig. Deine Perspektive: einen eigenen Bereich aufbauen. Du arbeitest unmittelbar mit mir sowie unseren Verantwortlichen für Sales und Coaching. Wir vereinbaren Ziele und Prioritäten. Du entwickelst Lösungen, wählst passende Tools aus und verantwortest die Umsetzung zunehmend eigenständig. Dass daraus mehr werden kann, zeigt Constantin Michel: Vor fünf Jahren als Werkstudent gestartet, ist er heute mit 25 geschäftsführender Gesellschafter unserer KI-Firma hinter CARvinci. Das ist keine garantierte Laufbahn – aber ein konkretes Beispiel dafür, wie viel Verantwortung hier möglich ist. Qualifikation Du kannst einen Workflow bauen und einem Geschäftsführer erklären, warum er wirtschaftlich sinnvoll ist. Praktische KI-Erfahrung: Du hast mit Claude und ChatGPT gearbeitet, einen eigenen GPT oder vergleichbaren Assistenten eingerichtet und erste Automatisierungen gebaut oder getestet – beispielsweise mit Make oder n8n. Analytisches Denken und Umsetzungskraft: Du verstehst wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge, beherrschst Excel und machst aus einer Idee eine funktionierende Lösung. Außergewöhnliche Struktur: Du behältst parallele Programme und Termine im Blick, hältst Zusagen nach und testest Abläufe, bevor Kunden damit arbeiten. Eigenverantwortung und Kommunikation: Du klärst Fragen professionell, meldest Probleme frühzeitig und gehst konstruktiv mit direktem Feedback um. Auch operative Routine und praktisches Anpacken gehören für dich dazu. Ein Studium in BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Digital Business oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich ist eine gute Grundlage, aber keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind dein Können, dein Anspruch und deine Umsetzungskraft – nicht allein dein Abschluss. Automobilwissen brauchst du zum Einstieg nicht. Benefits Gestaltungsspielraum statt langer Freigabewege: Du darfst Prozesse verändern, passende Software auswählen und neue Lösungen umsetzen. Entscheidend sind nachvollziehbare Ergebnisse und ein verantwortungsvoller Umgang mit Daten und Budget. Weiterbildung nach Bedarf statt nach Restbudget: KI-Ausbildungen, Automatisierung, Projektmanagement und persönliche Entwicklung. Sag uns, was du brauchst und wofür. Ein sinnvoller Kurs scheitert nicht an einem aufgebrauchten pauschalen Jahresbudget. Ausstattung, die zu deiner Arbeit passt: Premiumzugänge zu benötigten KI-Tools, MacBook oder Windows-Laptop, Firmenhandy, klimatisiertes Büro und höhenverstellbare Schreibtische. Dazu Firmenfitness, PrepMyMeal und Getränke. Langfristige Zusammenarbeit und Zeit außerhalb des Jobs: Unbefristete Position, 30 Tage Urlaub plus Geburtstag frei und 1–2 Tage Homeoffice nach Abstimmung. An Live-Trainingstagen bist du in Münster. Regelmäßige deutschlandweite Dienstreisen und Hotelübernachtungen gehören nicht zum normalen Arbeitsalltag. Dein Einstiegsgehalt innerhalb der genannten Spanne richtet sich nach deinen Fähigkeiten und der Verantwortung, die du bereits eigenständig übernehmen kannst. Dass daraus mehr werden kann, zeigt Constantin Michel: Vor fünf Jahren als Werkstudent gestartet, ist er heute mit 25 geschäftsführender Gesellschafter unserer KI-Firma hinter CARvinci. Das ist keine garantierte Laufbahn – aber ein konkretes Beispiel dafür, wie viel Verantwortung hier möglich ist.

Qualifikation

  • Praktische KI-Erfahrung: Du hast mit Claude und ChatGPT gearbeitet, einen eigenen GPT oder vergleichbaren Assistenten eingerichtet und erste Automatisierungen gebaut oder getestet – beispielsweise mit Make oder n8n.

  • Außergewöhnliche Struktur: Du behältst parallele Programme und Termine im Blick, hältst Zusagen nach und testest Abläufe, bevor Kunden damit arbeiten.
  • Eigenverantwortung und Kommunikation: Du klärst Fragen professionell, meldest Probleme frühzeitig und gehst konstruktiv mit direktem Feedback um. Auch operative Routine und praktisches Anpacken gehören für dich dazu.

Ein Studium in BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Digital Business oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich ist eine gute Grundlage, aber keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind dein Können, dein Anspruch und deine Umsetzungskraft – nicht allein dein Abschluss. Automobilwissen brauchst du zum Einstieg nicht.

Job Description

✨ A little about us

Container xChange is building the distribution channel for global container trading.

We operate in a huge, fragmented and still highly inefficient market. Our ambition is to make it dramatically easier to access the right inventory, compare opportunities, transact and fulfil container purchases across sellers and locations globally.

To win, we need to get a few things exceptionally right: more of the right containers, in the right locations, at better prices — from sellers who are fast, reliable and easy to trade with.

That is where you come in.

🧭 The Role

As Product Engineer – Procurement, you will own our Procurement function end-to-end in close collaboration with our CEO Christian.

This is a hands-on commercial builder role: you run Procurement, improve the economics, and build the processes, automations and product solutions that make the function scale.

You will start hands-on: run day-to-day procurement, work directly with sellers, negotiate prices and promotions, support Sales on supply opportunities and understand where our current processes work well — and where they break.

But your mandate goes further: Build a Procurement function that becomes a competitive advantage for xChange.

We want you to constantly ask: How can we improve the economics? How can we make this process faster? What can we standardize? What can we automate?

You will use Claude and other tools to build lightweight solutions yourself, experiment with deterministic and agentic automation, and work closely with Engineering where solutions need to become part of our core product.

Over time, repetitive operational work should decrease while your focus on Seller Performance, Procurement strategy, automation and product improvements grows.

📍 Location

This is a position based in Hamburg, where you will work closely with our Sales, Product and Engineering team as well as directly with our CEO Christian.

Requirements

🚀 Your Impact

Ultimately, your work should help xChange transact more containers at better margins, while allowing Procurement to scale without scaling manual work at the same rate.

You will:

  • Own and run day-to-day Procurement and tactical Seller Management, using what you learn from operating the processes yourself to continuously improve, streamline and automate the function.
  • Improve our buying economics and Seller Performance by identifying pricing opportunities, negotiating with sellers, driving promotions and improving listing quality, reply speed, release speed and reliability.
  • Use Claude and other tools as part of your day-to-day work to solve problems faster and improve our processes and systems.
  • Build lightweight, bootstrapped solutions yourself when they can solve an immediate problem — from deterministic workflows to agentic solutions.
  • Work closely with Engineering when those solutions need to become more robust, scalable or part of our core product.
  • Build a more systematic, data-driven view of Procurement, so we can identify and prioritize the biggest opportunities across our seller portfolio.
  • Drive larger strategic initiatives such as gatebuy, future pickups and new ways of sourcing inventory that help us build a structurally better trading engine.

🌟 What Makes You a Great Fit?

We are looking for someone who combines commercial intuition, strong execution and a product/automation mindset.

You are likely a great fit if you:

  • Get genuine satisfaction from negotiating a better deal and spotting commercial opportunities others might miss.
  • Have a passion for trading, pricing and markets — whether that comes from work, the stock market, sports betting or simply how you think.
  • Are commercially confident enough to own seller relationships, make decisions independently and push back when needed.
  • Perform well under pressure and at speed — matching the pace of Sales without sacrificing accuracy.
  • Are highly structured and operationally reliable: fast without becoming sloppy.
  • Enjoy getting your hands dirty and executing the work yourself.
  • Think beyond individual cases and naturally ask how a process can be improved at a system level.
  • Can balance short-term execution with long-term improvement — improving processes, automation and scalability over time.
  • Are data-driven and comfortable using metrics to identify opportunities.
  • Already use AI to solve real-world problems and are excited about building prototypes, workflows and automations.
  • Can translate a business problem into something Engineering can work with.
  • Have strong ownership, drive and the learning velocity to grow further into product and automation.

You do not need to be a software engineer. We care much more about your ability to understand a problem deeply, imagine a better solution, prototype where possible and collaborate effectively with Engineers.

Deep container knowledge and traditional Procurement experience are also not prerequisites.

This role might not be for you if…

  • You prefer having perfect information before making decisions — this role requires fast judgment under uncertainty.
  • You don’t enjoy working in a high-pressure, fast-moving commercial environment where Procurement needs to match the pace of Sales.
  • You prefer staying at one level of the problem rather than switching between what needs to happen now, what needs to change commercially, and what needs to improve in the process or product.
  • You prefer clearly bounded responsibilities over end-to-end ownership — we expect you to take decisions, push back on sellers when needed, and stay accountable until the issue is actually resolved.

👀 What to Expect

  • A rare combination of commercial and product ownership: You will understand and improve the full Procurement system — from the economics of individual trades to the processes and technology behind the function.
  • A role that evolves with you: You will initially spend significant time running Procurement hands-on. As you improve and automate the function, your role should increasingly shift toward Seller Performance, Procurement economics, product and automation.
  • Direct exposure to the business: You will work closely with our CEO Christian and have direct visibility into how supply, pricing and seller performance translate into containers transacted and margin.
  • Build rather than inherit: You are not joining a mature Procurement function with a fixed playbook. You will help define how Procurement at xChange should work in the future, from how we manage sellers today to how much of the function can eventually be automated.
  • AI as a real working tool: We expect you to use tools such as Claude to increase your own leverage and continuously challenge which parts of your job still need to be done manually.
  • The long-term opportunity is to help build a Procurement engine that becomes one of xChange’s core competitive advantages.

Nous accompagnons l'adoption et la performance chez les plus grandes entreprises mondiales (Stellantis, General Motors, Michelin, La Poste, Pernod Ricard, et d'autres). En tant que Solution Engineer, vous êtes le pont technique entre nos clients et la plateforme : vous participez aux ateliers client, vous captez les besoins, puis vous utilisez le développement assisté par IA (Claude Code, Windsurf et notre outillage d'agents interne) pour configurer, intégrer et étendre la plateforme InsideBoard, souvent dans la même semaine. Ce n'est pas un poste d'ingénieur logiciel classique, et vous n'avez pas besoin de maîtriser toutes les technologies de notre stack. Vous orchestrez des agents IA sur un écosystème interne bien documenté (surface d'API, automatisation n8n, conventions pensées pour les agents). L'IA écrit la majeure partie du code ; votre travail consiste à savoir ce qu'elle fait, à vérifier qu'elle fait la bonne chose, et à l'arrêter quand ce n'est pas le cas. Et vous portez la relation client sur le volet technique. Vos missions Face au client (environ 50 %) Animer des ateliers de cadrage et de spécification avec des clients grands comptes (en français et en anglais), du kickoﬀ aux comités de pilotage (COPIL). Transformer les réunions en livrables actionnables : spécifications fonctionnelles, matrices de statut, wireframes, guides d'intégration, guides utilisateur, comptes rendus avec décisions validées. Défendre des arbitrages face au client : configuration standard ou développement spécifique, vision cible ou solution pragmatique, et assumer la recommandation. Répondre aux revues de sécurité et aux questions de due diligence technique ; rédiger des analyses de cause racine en cas d'incident de production. Configuration de la plateforme et données (environ 50 %) Configurer la plateforme InsideBoard via son interface d'administration ou ses API : KPIs (formules, agrégation, fréquences), plans d'action et programmes de coaching, challenges, guidance, sections de profil, champs personnalisés, formulaires, notifications, imports d'utilisateurs, de départements et de tags. Construire et maintenir des workflows d'automatisation n8n : webhooks, tâches planifiées, synthèses générées par IA, pipelines de contenu RAG, alerting d'erreurs centralisé vers Slack. Scripter des opérations de données en Python ou TypeScript : migrations en masse avec discipline dry-run et rollback, audits de licences, rapports d'engagement, échanges Excel/CSV/SFTP avec les DSI clientes. Brancher des fonctionnalités LLM pour les clients : synthèses de performance générées par IA, pipelines OCR, bases de connaissances RAG, conception de prompts d'agents. Le profil recherché Vous n'avez pas besoin de connaître toutes les technologies que nous utilisons. Il vous faut assez de profondeur technique pour superviser une IA qui les connaît : comprendre son plan, poser les bonnes questions, repérer quand elle dérive, et valider le résultat avant qu'il n'atteigne un client. Indispensable Une vraie maîtrise des agents de code IA (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf ou équivalent) : vous savez spécifier une tâche précisément, piloter l'agent, relire sa production avec un œil critique et vérifier le résultat. Vous savez aussi quand ne pas lui faire confiance. Une capacité de contrôle technique : vous lisez un diﬀ ou un log suﬃsamment bien pour comprendre ce qui a changé et pourquoi, vous suivez un appel API de bout en bout, vous vérifiez la cohérence d'une transformation de données et vous testez ce que l'IA a construit avant de livrer. Écrire du code de zéro n'est pas exigé. Une aisance avec les API REST : authentification, pagination, rate limits ; à l'aise avec la plomberie de données JSON/CSV/XLSX. Une excellente communication client en français et en anglais : vous savez animer un atelier, recadrer avec diplomatie et écrire des documents qu'un DSI lira. De la rigueur et de la prudence avec les données de production : dry-runs, plans de rollback,logs. Vous faites mesurer deux fois à l'IA avant toute mise à jour en masse. Un plus Une expérience de développement (TypeScript, Python), utile mais non requise. Une expérience avec n8n, Zapier, Make ou une plateforme d'automatisation similaire. Une exposition aux écosystèmes d'entreprise : Salesforce, Dynamics 365, SAP , SSO. Une expérience d'intégration LLM (API OpenAI/Anthropic/Mistral, RAG, conception de prompts). Un passé en adoption SaaS, conduite du changement ou customer success engineering. Processus de recrutement : Un appel initial de 15 minutes sera programmé avec Shelly dès que votre candidature sera approuvée puis un entretien RH avec Shelly de nouveau. Ensuite, vous aurez un entretien d'une heure pour discuter de vos expériences, motivations et de notre entreprise avec Sébastien Vous rencontrerez votre future manager, Manan , pour discuter plus en détail du rôle, de vos compétences et de ce que nous pouvons vous offrir. Enfin, un appel téléphonique avec Michael, l'un des directeurs d'InsideBoard AI, clôturera le processus. Ce que nous offrons • Une opportunité de travailler dans une entreprise innovante et en pleine croissance. • Un environnement de travail collaboratif et stimulant. • Des possibilités de développement professionnel et de montée en compétences. • Des événements d’équipe réguliers et une culture d’entreprise conviviale. Nous sommes un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances, et notre programme de diversité et d’inclusion vise à faire de VO2 Group un lieu de travail idéal pour des talents variés. title: Senior Backend-Entwickler – Agents (100% Remote in Deutschland)
description: Wir suchen Senior Developer, die in unserem vollständig remoten Team an unseren Agenten arbeiten. Wenn du Komplexität magst und willst, dass deine Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegt, passt du zu uns. Über uns Hausverwalter.ai ist eine All-in-One-Plattform für Hausverwaltungen, mit Funktionen wie Inbox, CRM, Dokumenten, Telefonie, Video Calls, Team Chat und KI-Agenten. Unsere Mission ist es, alles zu automatisieren, was ein Hausverwalter tut. Über die Rolle Unsere Plattform ist von Tag eins an agentisch gedacht. Bevor wir überhaupt die UI geplant haben, haben wir geplant, wie Agenten mit der Software arbeiten. Denk dran – unser Ziel ist, die ganze Branche zu automatisieren, und das meinen wir ernst. Heute gibt es für fast alles, was der Nutzer in der UI machen kann, ein Agenten-Tool, und der Co-Pilot (der tägliche Assistent des Nutzers) kann alles für ihn übernehmen, sogar den Dark Mode an- und ausschalten. Aber der Co-Pilot ist erst der Anfang. Die eigentliche Herausforderung sind die autonomen Agenten. Dazu unten mehr. Woran du arbeiten wirst Inbox-Agents: Autonome Agenten, die anspringen, sobald in einem Ticket etwas Neues passiert. Kunden trainieren sie selbst ODER nehmen einfach eine der Vorlagen, die du für sie baust. Diese Agenten können heute schon komplette komplexe Abläufe allein übernehmen und sind einer der Hauptgründe, warum sich Kunden für unsere Software interessieren. Aber wann sollte ein Agent an einen Menschen abgeben, statt selbst zu Ende zu machen? Wie stellen wir sicher, dass er sich an den Prozess hält? Das sind deine Fragen. Harness Engineering: Der Agent hat über 100 Tools. Aber er muss eine Anfrage so verstehen, wie ein Hausverwalter sie versteht, und nicht so, wie die Begriffe außerhalb der Branche klingen. Was gehört in den System Prompt, was in Skills? Knowledge Base: Unsere Plattform hat eine eigene Knowledge Base, ähnlich wie Notion. Komplett selbst gebaut und gedacht als kollektives Gehirn des Unternehmens. Aber sollte die KI auch von selbst „lernen"? Und wenn ja, wann? Und wie machen wir die Suche in der Knowledge Base besser — über bessere Tools, System Prompts oder Skills? Voice-Agents: Dieselben Agenten, nur am Telefon — auf LiveKit gebaut, die Anrufe genauso abwickeln wie unsere Text-Agenten Tickets. LLM Infrastructure. Das richtige Modell für die jeweilige Aufgabe wählen, per Caching und Streaming die Latenz drücken, bei Provider-Ausfällen sauber neu versuchen, Context kompakt halten, die RAG-Suche optimieren, Usage über alle Provider tracken, Kosten senken und mit Evals prüfen, was wirklich besser ist. Unser minimalistischer Tech Stack Alles ist TypeScript. Vom Datenbankschema bis ins Frontend. Backend: Convex (Datenbank & Serverless Functions) Frontend: Next.js , React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui Technologien, die dir begegnen werden: Vercel AI SDK, Convex Agent Component Gehalt 5000 – 6000 Euro brutto, mit Raum für Wachstum und Beförderungen in den kommenden Monaten und Jahren Benefits 100 % remote Flexible Arbeitszeiten So viele KI-Tokens, wie du brauchst Wir sind eigenfinanziert und profitabel (und verbrennen kein VC-Geld, um zu überleben) Kleines Team, echte Verantwortung — was du baust, geht auch wirklich live Schnelle Entscheidungen, keine sinnlosen Meetings und keine Freigabeschleifen, durch die du dich kämpfen musst Unsere Werte Dinge fertig machen, jeder Tag zählt Transparenz und Ehrlichkeit, gerade wenn es unangenehm wird Nach Großem streben – dich und andere ständig fordern Wenn du genauer sehen willst, was wir bauen: Schau auf unserem YouTube-Kanal vorbei — kleiner Hinweis, der ist auf Deutsch. Du bist fließend in Englisch und Deutsch ein erfahrener Entwickler mit mehr als 2 Jahren Erfahrung im Bauen von Agenten für den Produktivbetrieb AI-native. Du hast agentische Features ausgeliefert, auf die sich echte Nutzer verlassen, und du hast eine Meinung zu Retrieval, Evals, Tool-Design und dazu, wo die heutigen Spitzenmodelle an ihre Grenzen kommen. in erster Linie Builder. Du bringst lieber heute eine grobe v1 raus, als drei Wochen lang die perfekte zu planen. auf dem neuesten Stand bei neuen KI-Modellen und der Forschung jemand, der fast seinen gesamten Code mit KI schreibt es gewohnt, autonom zu arbeiten und volle Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben zu übernehmen unter Leistungsdruck sogar noch besser schnell darin, Neues zu lernen, und siehst dich als Generalist, nicht als Spezialist Dein Techstack : Ist nicht wichtig, da bei uns KI deinen Code schreiben wird. title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: At Phantasma Labs, we're building AI-powered production scheduling software for manufacturers. Production scheduling is a complex problem: priorities change, machines go down, new orders come in and planners constantly need to adapt. Many factories still rely heavily on manual planning to manage this complexity. We approach this differently. Our technology combines reinforcement learning with Digital Twin environments to train AI agents in simulation, allowing manufacturers to create and optimize production schedules without relying on large historical datasets. We're already working with manufacturers across Europe, the US and Japan and partner with ERP and MES providers to bring our technology into real production environments. We're a small, international team based in Berlin with a flexible remote setup, and there's still a lot to build as we continue developing the product and bringing it to more manufacturers. raw.title: Machine Learning Engineer
raw.description:
At Phantasma Labs, we're building AI-powered production scheduling software for manufacturers. Production scheduling is a complex problem: priorities change, machines go down, new orders come in and planners constantly need to adapt. Many factories still rely heavily on manual planning to manage this complexity.

We approach this differently. Our technology combines reinforcement learning with Digital Twin environments to train AI agents in simulation, allowing manufacturers to create and optimize production schedules without relying on large historical datasets.

We're already working with manufacturers across Europe, the US and Japan and partner with ERP and MES providers to bring our technology into real production environments. We're a small, international team based in Berlin with a flexible remote setup, and there's still a lot to build as we continue developing the product and bringing it to more manufacturers.

Tasks

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you'll work on the core AI behind our production scheduling software. You'll develop and improve our reinforcement learning agents, work on the Digital Twin environments they train in and help turn complex manufacturing problems into models that work in real factories.

You'll have a lot of ownership over how we approach these problems and work closely with both our engineering team and customers. We're looking for someone who brings strong Python experience together with an understanding of manufacturing environments and wants to apply reinforcement learning to real-world production challenges.

  • Write robust, scalable and production-ready Python code
  • Provide code reviews, guidance, and mentorship to fellow developers to maintain high coding standards
  • Write unit and integration tests using tools such as unittest and pytest
  • Design, engineer and optimize features in the Digital Twin for reinforcement learning simulations using Python, NumPy and Pandas
  • Create, optimize and maintain training and evaluation scripts for RL agents
  • Set up and maintain Python environments using modern tools such as uv and conda
  • Work collaboratively using git (GitHub)
  • Participate in customer calls to understand requirements and translate them into actionable technical features
  • Brainstorm and develop ideas to improve the RL agent, including algorithms, reward functions and architecture

Requirements

Must haves

  • A background in Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Machine Learning, Industrial Engineering or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience with Python
  • 2+ years of experience in factory shopfloor operations as an engineer or planner, or 2+ years of experience working with ERP/MES systems for factories
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes across different production environments, including discrete manufacturing, line production and engineer-to-order
  • Basic understanding of reinforcement learning and experience developing or applying RL algorithms

Nice to haves

  • 3+ years of experience in factory shopfloor operations as an engineer or planner, or 3+ years of experience working with ERP/MES systems for factories
  • Research experience in developing RL algorithms
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, particularly GitHub Actions
  • Experience with libraries and tools such as PyTorch, Optuna and MLflow

Benefits

  • Ownership from day 1: Work in a small team with fast feedback and see the impact of what you build
  • Collaborate with a strong team: Work alongside ML specialists developing our AI optimization technology and software engineers building the production-grade systems around it
  • A supportive, open culture: clear communication, strong collaboration and flat hierarchies
  • Flexible working hours & hybrid setup: work remotely or from our Co-working space in Berlin Mitte, whatever helps you do your best work
  • Company laptop: We'll provide the equipment you need to do your work

Sounds Like a Fit?

If this sounds like your type of challenge, we'd love to hear from you! Don't worry if you don't tick every single box. If you're excited about the role, willing to learn and ready to take ownership, apply anyway!
